capabilities: : Converts Figma links into inline previews
extras: Requires public sharing of Figma files; private files will show a fallback card.
intentEvidence: The Obsidian Figma Embed plugin allows you to seamlessly integrate Figma designs into your Obsidian notes.
problem: The difficulty of viewing and referencing external Figma designs within Obsidian notes without leaving the application.
summary: Plugin that allows users to embed Figma designs directly into Obsidian notes, generating interactive, inline previews from Figma links.
